text:
lucas (product): quick thread: customers asking for a clear deliverable list for enterprise compliance — audit export format, external key support, retention lanes. need minimal MVP scope.
tara (eng): propose minimal MVP: 1) external-key handshake to cloud KMS, 2) 90-day searchable audit index, 3) tenant retention flag + TTL job. keep archival out of MVP.
meera (security): must include key metadata logging (key-id, attestation-token if available) and rotate-checks. also define what qualifies as 'searchable'.
dan (sales): two pilots (TrustBank, RetailCo). TrustBank needs HSM attest, RetailCo okay with cloud KMS. timeline request: 6-8 weeks for pilot.
ivy (custeng): RetailCo pilot: wants exported NDJSON schema, ability to run on-demand exports, and tenant-level retention toggles. can accept phased handoff.
lucas (product): acceptance tests idea: - handshake: upload key reference, confirm audit entry with key-id; - export: NDJSON matches schema v0.1; - retention: set 7y -> TTL creates tombstone entry.
tara (eng): technical note: 90d hot search requires maintaining a hot index; 7y will be cold and need background rehydration for exports. will add cost estimate.
meera (security): for TrustBank, we should offer an integration path with partner HSM attestation instead of building it now. add contract clause: attestation subject to partner SLA.
contracts-bot: created ticket COMP-8810 "MVP compliance acceptance tests + partner attestation path" assigned to product/eng/security.
lucas (product): next steps: tara + meera draft tech-spec and test harness by EOW; dan to confirm pilot customers; ivy to schedule RetailCo kickoff. keep MVP tight.
